{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check basic info
print("Shape:", sales.shape)
print("\nColumns:", sales.columns.tolist())
print("\nChannel values:", sales['channel'].unique())
print("\nStatus values:", sales['status'].unique())
print("\nCustomer segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())
print("\nUnique order_id count:", sales['order_id'].nunique())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("\nQA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print("\nMissing age (value -1):", len(missing_age))

# Check revenue dtype and sample
print("\nRevenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("\nSample of revenue:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
